_comment: Read by Deploy-Image.ps1 inside WinPE. Leave share.path empty for USB-only use. Everything else about a deployment is in AnswerFiles\*.xml.

remote._comment: Remote reimaging. wakePort: UDP port for Wake-on-LAN magic packets. wdsServer: the WDS server that PCs PXE boot from, for the no-F12 option (empty = the wds.server setting, or this PC).
